eod.conclusion: Indian equities closed sharply lower after failing to sustain early gains, with financial stocks leading the decline. The session saw whipsaw action as initial optimism around reduced volatility gave way to broad-based selling pressure. Regulatory developments and IPO activity provided counterpoints to the dominant risk-off sentiment, though earnings season anticipation failed to prevent the late-day retreat across major benchmarks.
